verdict.rationale: First-party practice pages say Cooley handles 2,100+ VC financings a year, split equally between investor and company representation. They also say it serves as primary counsel to 950+ funds with an understanding of 'trends, terms and key industry players.' Its free quarterly Venture Financing Report on Cooley GO Data shows it publishes market-terms data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that its two-sided market-terms knowledge works in practice; all evidence is vendor-claimed.
